findings.description: Potential unsafe deserialization using protobuf json_format.Parse with ignore_unknown_fields=False
findings.reasoning: This line uses google.protobuf.json_format.Parse() to parse JSON content into a Protocol Buffer object with ignore_unknown_fields=False. While protobuf JSON parsing is generally safer than pickle/yaml deserialization, there may be risks with custom extensions or unknown fields. The ignore_unknown_fields=False setting means unknown fields will cause parsing to fail, which could be safer. However, this requires manual review to determine if the protobuf message definitions have any custom extensions or dangerous field types that could be exploited.
